words: Hold audit after two paw builds short of the clay (B-kgav thin pads, B-gsn9 boxes): brush-built digits reach the measured numbers but not the organic shape, the same stall the head showed with hand-placed masses. Limiting assumption: paws are authored. Outcome: change the method per roster rule 12: reconstruct the paws from the clay paw crops (hind from the side and three-quarter, fore from the front), graft below 65 mm, keep the authored claws re-seated; all four paws in one pass on the merged file (tail and forelegs applied).
